title: SB5845 (2021-2022 Regular): Updating laws concerning civil protection orders to further enhance and improve their efficacy and accessibility.

other_topics: judicial-access-to-justice: Secs. 3-24, 27-33 (RCW 7.105 and related) — court procedures for civil protection orders: e-filing and case tracking, service, hearings, transfer of cases, judicial training, minor children as protected parties

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2021-22/Htm/Bills/Senate%20Bills/5845.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced (HTML, marks visible; 2022 session). Large protection-order clean-up bill (chapter 7.105 RCW); only the gun parts are quoted. Also: Sec. 25 (RCW 9.41.040) strikes 'domestic violence' before 'protection order' so firearm-ban triggering violations cover any protection order; Sec. 26 (RCW 9.41.801) edits surrender and service rules and strikes 'or defendant'; Sec. 9 and Sec. 18 revise service and surrender procedures (law enforcement collects firearms; personal service required in cases requiring surrender of firearms); Sec. 31 touches unemployment benefits (RCW 50.20.050). Several sections carry an emergency clause and effective date.
